name: Dagger
text: A short double-edged blade, easy to hide and quick to draw.

name: Tanto
text: An Akaviri knife with a chisel point, made to pierce armour at close quarters.

name: Staff
text: A long shaft of seasoned wood, as useful for walking as for breaking heads.

name: Shortsword
text: A soldier's sidearm: short, sturdy and easy to draw in a crowded fight.

name: Wakizashi
text: The shorter companion of the katana, curved and keen in the Akaviri manner.

name: Broadsword
text: A wide straight blade with a heavy cutting edge, favoured by Breton knights.

name: Saber
text: A curved cavalry blade that cuts cleanly from the saddle.

name: Longsword
text: A straight blade for one hand or two, the mark of a trained swordsman.

name: Katana
text: A single-edged Akaviri sword, folded and polished until it parts silk.

name: Claymore
text: A great two-handed sword of the northern highlands, heavy enough to cleave shields.

name: Dai-katana
text: The long two-handed sword of Akaviri masters, as graceful as it is deadly.

name: Mace
text: A flanged head on a short haft, made to dent plate.

name: Flail
text: A spiked ball on a chain that swings around shields and over parries.

name: Warhammer
text: A heavy hammer with a spike behind its face, built to crush armour.

name: Battle Axe
text: A broad-bladed axe for two hands, as old as war itself.

name: War Axe
text: A one-handed axe with a bearded blade, cruel in the cut.

name: Short Bow
text: A compact bow of horn and wood, quick to draw in close country.

name: Long Bow
text: A tall bow of yew that sends arrows far and hard.

name: Arrow
text: A fletched shaft with a sharpened head, useless without a bow.

name: Archer's Axe
text: A light axe an archer keeps at the belt for close fighting.

name: Light Flail
text: A lighter flail that recovers quickly after a swing.

name: Dwarven Thunderlock
text: A Dwemer long gun that hurls brass pellets with a roar of steam and thunder.

name: Dwemer Pellet
text: A small brass ball cast for Dwemer firearms.

name: Dwarven Pistolet
text: A one-handed Dwemer firearm, short of barrel and loud of voice.

name: Hand Wraps
text: Strips of cloth wound around the knuckles to spare them in a brawl.
